summary: Backend: 21/21 pytest cases passed (auth OTP, wallet, 11 /games/play game_types, interactive crash start/status/cashout/settle, feed=15 entries, dice win-rate ~38% over 200 spins). Frontend (mobile viewport 390x844): login -> dev OTP -> verify -> Home works; Games tab shows 11 category chips and 13 game cards; Dice game plays end-to-end (balance 50->40, result box shows, controls disabled during busy); Crash game interactive flow works - cash-out-btn appears while flying and tapping settles the round with correct balance update. IMPORTANT: On first observation the payment_config.player_win_rate was already at 0.8 from prior admin testing (not a bug in the code) which caused the win-rate assertion to see 78%; after resetting to 0.38 it produced 33% over 200 plays (inside 30-46 band). Only web-style deprecation console warnings observed ('shadow*' -> boxShadow, props.pointerEvents), no red screen, no API 5xx.

minor.issue: UpsertPaymentConfigIn does not include player_win_rate so admin cannot update win rate through this endpoint; win rate is only editable via /api/admin/app-settings. Not blocking (separate endpoint exists) but the two admin endpoints should ideally be consolidated or documented.

issues: First OTP input has maxLength=6 to accept pasted codes; on web the pasted 6-digit value is auto-split correctly and boxes fill (verified).

react_native_issues.issue: React Native Web deprecation warnings 'shadow* style props are deprecated. Use boxShadow.' emitted repeatedly in console. Search StyleSheet.create for shadowColor/shadowOpacity/shadowOffset/shadowRadius and migrate to boxShadow (or gate for web).
Deprecation warning 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' likely from a View passing pointerEvents=... as prop. Move to style.pointerEvents.

action_items: (Optional) Migrate shadow* style props to boxShadow to clear RN-Web deprecation warnings.
(Optional) Move pointerEvents from prop to style to clear RN deprecation warning.
(Optional) Expose player_win_rate on /api/admin/payment-config PATCH so a single admin call can update both payment and economics config.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~1080 lines - consider splitting into modules (auth/, games/, admin/, wallet/) once the surface grows further.
Interactive /games/crash/cashout correctly hides crash_point until crashed (anti-cheat) - verified.
MongoDB _id is stripped consistently via clean() helper - good.
All /api endpoints prefixed correctly; CORS wide-open which is fine for this preview stage.
seed_data_creation: Test users are created via random 10-digit +91 phones on the fly. Reset payment_config.player_win_rate to 0.38 in Mongo to correct prior admin tampering during economics test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Player win rate lives in db.payment_config.player_win_rate (not env). If economics tests fail with a huge win rate, first check that value in Mongo - previous manual admin testing had left it at 0.8. Use POST /api/admin/app-settings {player_win_rate: 0.38} with admin token to reset.
rca_of_issue: N/A - no blocking bugs. Only pre-existing DB state (player_win_rate=0.8 from prior admin tests) had to be reset for the economics assertion.
